params.body: With OWN_PRESIGNER on, staging still spent 3.7 s and 10.6 s in sign_urls on the first visit of a vehicle detail page: DemoMediaDisk::resolve() asked S3 (HEAD) per URL whether the file lives under demo/, 150 times, then cached for five minutes. Derived sizes (_afgeleid/...) are only ever written by this environment, so they are under demo/ by definition: resolved without a HEAD. Originals may come from the shared real folder and still ask (cached). Staging only; production has no wrapper.
params.title: Staging: no HEAD per derived URL (first detail visit was 4 to 10 s)
